title: Major defense stocks surge to all-time highs after Trump's tough rhetoric against North Korea
关键词: SPDR S&P Aerospace and Defense ETF
主要内容: Defense stocks surged to all-time highs following President Trump's strong rhetoric against North Korea, with Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Raytheon hitting new highs. The SPDR S&P Aerospace and Defense ETF rose 29% since the Nov. 8 election, outperforming the S&P 500's 16% gain. The White House proposed a nearly 10% increase in defense spending to $603 billion for fiscal 2018 in February. The rally occurred amid broader market declines due to geopolitical tensions.

股票实体.名称: SPDR S&P Aerospace and Defense ETF
